title: The Detection of Dust Gap-ring Structure in the Outer Region of the CR Cha Protoplanetary Disk
question: Does the CR Cha disk have dust gap/ring substructure, and what mechanism (planet gap opening or dust trapping at a gas temperature/pressure bump) could produce it?

evidence.quote: $\rm \kappa_{\rm 225GHz}=2.3~cm^{2}~g^{-1}$ (cite: Beckwith1990) is the dust opacity at 225 GHz.

what.value: Stellar parameters: M*=1.657 Msun, Teff 4800 K, R*=3.113 Rsun

evidence.quote: We adopt the stellar mass of $\rm 1.657~M_{\odot}$, the effective temperature of 4800 K, and the stellar radius of $\rm 3.113~R_{\rm \odot}$ (cite: Villebrun2019).
We also assume the abundance ratio of $\rm^{12}CO/C^{18}O=444$ and $\rm ^{12}CO/^{13}CO=67$ (cite: Qi2011).

what.value: C18O molecular data (S mu^2, Eu/k) from LAMDA and CDMS

evidence.quote: from the Leiden Atomic and Molecular Database (cite: Schoier2005) and Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (cite: Muller2001CDMS)

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, then CLEAN with Briggs robust 0 (continuum) and 2.0 (CO), phase self-cal on continuum
Ellipse fitting of continuum with imfit
Azimuthal averaging in 8 au annuli within r<240 au; CO uses only the southern half-disk to avoid absorption

recipe.goal: Gas temperature from peak brightness temperature
recipe.method: Moment 8 maps without continuum subtraction; I_peak=B_nu(T_B,peak); fit power law + Gaussian over 20-200 au
assumptions: 12CO and 13CO optically thick so T_B = T_gas

recipe.goal: Dust surface density and gap fit
recipe.method: Sigma_dust from I_cont=B(T)(1-exp(-tau)), tau=kappa*Sigma; fit baseline power-law with exponential tail plus Gaussian gap

recipe.goal: C18O column density and dust-to-CO-gas ratio
recipe.method: Optical depth from Gaussian-fitted azimuthally averaged spectra (velocity-shifted by moment 1) with T_gas=T_B(13CO); column density via Yamamoto 2017 equation; N_CO=444 N_C18O
Fit Kanagawa et al. 2017 gap profile; minimum mass from Rosotti et al. 2016; upper limits from non-detection of gas gap
assumptions: T=22 K at gap center 91.47 au; M*=1.657 Msun; dust traces gas gap

recipe.method: HO-CHUNK Monte Carlo RT with compact dust disk (20-100 au), small and large grain populations, to get r-z temperature and 12CO/13CO photospheres
assumptions: n(a)∝a^-3.5; small 0.0025-0.2 um, large 0.01 um-1 mm; small surface density 10x smaller than large

evidence.quote: The total flux density of the dust disk is $\sim0.139$ Jy.
The estimated inclination of the disk is $31.0^{\circ}\pm1.4^{\circ}$ and disk PA is $36.2^{\circ}\pm1.8^{\circ}$.
